patthana22.5:1.1: na kusalo na sappaccayo dhammo kusalassa sappaccayassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. cha. saṅkhataṃ sappaccayasadisaṃ.
patthana22.5:2.1: nakusalattika nasanidassanaduke kusalattika sanidassanadukaṃ na kusalaṃ na sanidassanaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sanidassano dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana22.5:3.1: na kusalo na anidassano dhammo kusalassa anidassanassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. navapañhā kātabbā. nakusalattika nasappaṭighaduke kusalattika sappaṭighadukaṃ
patthana22.5:4.1: na kusalaṃ na sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana22.5:5.1: na kusalaṃ na appaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nakusalattika narūpīduke kusalattika rūpīdukaṃ
patthana22.5:6.1: na kusalaṃ na rūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato rūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana22.5:7.1: na kusalaṃ na arūpiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato arūpī dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. nakusalattika nalokiyaduke kusalattika lokiyadukaṃ
patthana22.5:8.1: na kusalaṃ na lokiyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato lokiyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca.
patthana22.5:9.1: na kusalaṃ na lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo lokuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: .. abyākato lokuttaro dhammo ... chapañhā kātabbā. nakusalattika nakenaciviññeyyaduke kusalattika kenaciviññeyyadukaṃ
patthana22.5:10.1: na kusalaṃ na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo kenaciviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā aṭṭhārasa.
patthana22.5:11.1: na kusalaṃ na kenacinaviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo kenacinaviññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā aṭṭhārasa. nakusalattika noāsavaduke kusalattika āsavadukaṃ na kusalaṃ no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
